---
title: "Claude Code for Researchers"
subtitle: "Slides, a runbook, and 18 installable skills for research work"
---

This site packages a working Claude Code setup for empirical research: the [slide deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1j67OxP7MQudUdp6t-OtCPzaASTS8nBktCXalzXrvC1g/present), a [CLAUDE.md template](TEMPLATE_CLAUDE.md), and [18 ready-to-install skills](skills/index.qmd).

Everything is free to fork, adapt, and re-share.

---

## Start here

If you have never used Claude Code before:

1. **Install Claude Code.** [Follow the official install guide](https://docs.anthropic.com/claude/docs/claude-code).
2. **Install WisprFlow** (optional but recommended). Talking beats typing.
3. **Copy the CLAUDE.md template.** Grab [`TEMPLATE_CLAUDE.md`](TEMPLATE_CLAUDE.md), fill in your own role, projects, and preferences, then save it to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`. No other setup step pays off as much.
4. **Install one skill.** Pick one from [the skills page](skills/index.qmd) that matches something you already do by hand. `/pipeline-audit` is a good first choice if you write papers; `/data-analysis` is a good first choice if you don't.

## Installing a skill

```bash
# From this repo's root:
cp -r skills/pipeline-audit ~/.claude/skills/
```

Restart Claude Code. The skill is now callable as `/pipeline-audit`.

12 of the 18 skills need configuration before first use. Grep for `{{` in a `SKILL.md` to find placeholder variables: paths, phone numbers, credentials. The "Needs config?" column on [the skills page](skills/index.qmd) lists the API keys, CLIs, and accounts required by each skill.

## About the walkthrough

**Intended reader:** an empirical researcher who runs studies, analyzes data, and writes papers. The material assumes roughly the skill level of a third-year PhD student in psychology.

**Running example:** a joke-writing task with AI assistance, agency measures, and peer ratings. The walkthrough builds the task first in Qualtrics, then rebuilds it as a self-hosted web app to show why self-hosting matters for reproducibility.

**Format:** roughly 50 minutes of live work across four sections (setup, survey design, data analysis, writing), plus 10 minutes of questions. Nothing is pre-recorded.

## Reporting bugs

File issues on [the repo](https://github.com/lirabenjamin/claude-code-for-researchers). If a skill breaks or a placeholder is missing, flag it.
